annotation.interpretation_a: The client discards cached values only for the server that was closed, and uses the defaults on the next connection to that server.
annotation.interpretation_b: The client discards all cached values for all servers, and uses the defaults on the next connection to any server.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify which cached values are to be discarded, leading to two materially different implementation behaviours.
